blocked_slices_2026_11_08.detail: The delta projection (_delta_for / _delta_state_root / _attach_delta, audit_integrity_token, three new audit-table columns) is the #246/#248/#251 token design. Adopting it means choosing between that token and the fork's incumbent restart checkpoint (0bd2b96) + digest cache (audit_parallel.py), and it changes canonical audit bytes/schema. The 567-line test_delta_audit_performance.py cannot pass without that slice. Also excluded with it: test_legacy_persisted_permit_without_expiry_fails_closed (Preview's fork treats NULL expires_at_ns as 'no expiry' on the bare state path; adopting the stricter invariant would change issue_permit semantics).

Fails identically against upstream base 6b3caac (verified in a scratch worktree): signed_envelope(..., signature='not-valid') is silently discarded because the helper always re-signs (signing_payload excludes the signature field), so the envelope is valid and the kernel allows. The test as written cannot produce the deny it asserts. Left as-is; fixing the helper/test is a separate upstream decision.
